question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over into next year?
answer: Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the next calendar year, and any carried‑over days must be used by 31 March of that year. [1] If you were unable to take PTO because of sickness or parental leave, you may carry over all unused days, which must be used within 12 months of your return to work. [2]
gold_answer: Up to 5 days, used by 31 March.

question: Can I use my personal laptop for company work when I work from home?

gold_answer: No; personal laptops may not be used for company work; use the company laptop. Personal phones only via the managed app.
